note: Live-session recording of the screen scenes (series/tools/rec). prepare/teardown run on the laptop, not recorded; commands are typed and run for real. Windows PowerShell 5.1 on CON-SRV02. The gotcha screen is an app screen because the user policy is read in a real sign-in as CONTOSO\jgoncalves at the VMConnect console.
prepare: Invoke-Command -Session $s2 { New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep03 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Invoke-Command -Session $s2 { Get-ChildItem C:\lab\ep03 -Recurse | Unblock-File; Install-WindowsFeature GPMC, RSAT-AD-PowerShell | Out-Null }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Test-Path "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" })) { if (-not (Test-Path $msi)) { Invoke-WebRequest "https://github.com/PowerShell/PowerShell/releases/download/v$v/PowerShell-$v-win-x64.msi" -OutFile $msi }; Copy-Item -ToSession $dc -Path $msi -Destination C:\lab\pwsh.msi -Force; Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Start-Process msiexec.exe "/i C:\lab\pwsh.msi /quiet ADD_PATH=1 ENABLE_PSREMOTING=1" -Wait } }

if (-not (Invoke-Command -Session $dc { Test-Path C:\lab\ep03-pw.xml })) { $pw = Read-Host -AsSecureString "Lab-only initial password for the demo users (owner types, never shown)"; Invoke-Command -Session $dc -ArgumentList $pw { param($p) New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force C:\lab | Out-Null; $p | Export-Clixml C:\lab\ep03-pw.xml } }
# episode 2 data is needed (OU tree, GG-Dept-Finance, jgoncalves): provisioned here from the episode 2 module when OU=Contoso is missing

Invoke-Command -Session $dc { if (-not (Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter "Name -eq 'Contoso'")) { & "C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe" -NoProfile -Command "Import-Module C:\lab\ep03-ad\src\AdLab\AdLab.psd1; Invoke-AdLabProvisioning -CsvPath C:\lab\ep03-ad\src\users.csv -DomainDn 'DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com' -UpnSuffix lab.contoso.com -InitialPassword (Import-Clixml C:\lab\ep03-pw.xml) | Out-Null" } }
# owner signs in: at the VMConnect console of CON-SRV02 sign in once as CONTOSO\jgoncalves (first sign-in forces the password change), then sign out
Read-Host 'Press Enter when jgoncalves has signed in once and out again' | Out-Null

Invoke-GpoLabDeployment -DefinitionPath .\gpo-definitions.json | Format-Table Gpo, Action, Target, Result -AutoSize
Invoke-GpoLabDeployment -DefinitionPath .\gpo-definitions.json | Format-Table Gpo, Action, Target, Result -AutoSize

screens.name: applied
commands: Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-SRV01 { gpupdate /force | Out-Null; gpresult /r /scope computer }

Invoke-Command -ComputerName CON-SRV01 { Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-PowerShell/Operational' -FilterXPath '*[System[EventID=4104]]' -MaxEvents 3 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, @{ n = 'ScriptBlock'; e = { $_.Message.Substring(0, [Math]::Min(80, $_.Message.Length)) } } -AutoSize }

screens.name: ms16072
screens.app: VMConnect: CON-SRV02 console (Windows PowerShell as lab Administrator, then a sign-in as CONTOSO\jgoncalves)
steps: As lab Administrator in Windows PowerShell 5.1: cd C:\lab\ep03\src; Import-Module .\GpoLab\GpoLab.psd1
Sign out; sign in to the CON-SRV02 console as CONTOSO\jgoncalves (password typed off camera); open a command prompt
gpresult /r /scope user   (capture exactly what it says about CON-Finance-ScreenLock; if /r only omits the GPO, run gpresult /h %TEMP%\gp.html and open it)
Sign out; sign in again as the lab Administrator
Show the row Permission Authenticated Users=GpoRead Done

Sign out, sign in as CONTOSO\jgoncalves, open a command prompt: gpresult /r /scope user (GPO now applied) and reg query "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Control Panel\Desktop" (ScreenSaverIsSecure 1, ScreenSaveTimeOut 900)
Split screen: broken gpresult left, fixed right. Do not claim that the screen locks (no screen saver is configured on the server)
mask: VMConnect title bar ("<VM> on <laptop name>") and the laptop taskbar
password prompts at the sign-in screen

screens.name: report
prepare: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { if (-not (Get-GPO -Name CON-Test-Empty -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-GPO -Name CON-Test-Empty -Comment "Planted for the episode 3 report" | Out-Null }; if (-not (Get-GPO -Name CON-Sales-Legacy -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { New-GPO -Name CON-Sales-Legacy | Set-GPRegistryValue -Key "HKCU\Software\Policies\Microsoft\Windows\Control Panel\Desktop" -ValueName ScreenSaveTimeOut -Type String -Value "600" | Out-Null; New-GPLink -Name CON-Sales-Legacy -Target "OU=Sales,OU=Users,OU=Contoso,DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com" | Out-Null }; (Get-GPO -Name CON-Sales-Legacy).GpoStatus = "UserSettingsDisabled" }

teardown: Invoke-Command -VMName CON-SRV02 -Credential $cred { foreach ($g in "CON-Test-Empty", "CON-Sales-Legacy", "CON-Servers-Baseline", "CON-Finance-ScreenLock") { Remove-GPO -Name $g -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }; foreach ($n in "CON-SRV01", "CON-SRV02") { Get-ADComputer -Identity $n | Move-ADObject -TargetPath "CN=Computers,DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com" }; Get-CimInstance Win32_UserProfile | Where-Object LocalPath -like "*jgoncalves*" | Remove-CimInstance -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep03 -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }

Invoke-Command -VMName CON-DC01 -Credential $cred { $ou = "OU=Contoso,DC=lab,DC=contoso,DC=com"; if (Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -Filter "DistinguishedName -eq '$ou'") { Get-ADOrganizationalUnit -SearchBase $ou -Filter * | Set-ADObject -ProtectedFromAccidentalDeletion $false; Remove-ADOrganizationalUnit -Identity $ou -Recursive -Confirm:$false }; Remove-Item C:\lab\ep03-ad, C:\lab\ep03-pw.xml -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
